block.description: CoreXY calibration. Homes Y against the Y-min switch first to establish the Y origin, parks the gantry a short distance clear of that switch, then probes X min and X max and measures X steps per centimetre from the entered track length. A limit switch already pressed at the start is nudged clear rather than treated as an error.

inputs.label: Selected ESP32
inputs.description: Connected ESP32 board that should run the X calibration routine.

inputs.label: X Track Length (cm)
inputs.description: Physical X travel in cm between the X-min and X-max limit switches.

inputs.label: Y Track Length (cm)
inputs.description: Physical Y travel in cm from the Y-min switch to the far end. Y is homed against the Y-min switch, which defines Y = 0; this value sets the Y track length used to bound later moves.

inputs.label: X Start Clearance (cm)
inputs.description: First move of the calibration: the gantry steps this far in +X before homing, so a mounted tool clears the tool holders before Y homes. Uses the estimated steps-per-cm; stops safely on the X-max switch if already at the far end. Set 0 to skip.

inputs.label: X Calibration Y (cm)
inputs.description: Y position in cm the gantry parks at, clear of the Y-min switch, while X is calibrated. Parked using the carried-over steps-per-cm estimate, then corrected onto this exact value once X measures the true steps per cm.

inputs.label: Limit Buffer (cm)
inputs.description: Safety gap kept between the usable workspace and every limit switch. User coordinate 0 sits this far off the min switch and the usable max is the track length minus one buffer at each end, so moves to 0 or to the max stop short of the switches instead of tripping them. Changing it re-derives the ranges on the move blocks.

inputs.label: X End Clearance (cm)
inputs.description: Last move of the calibration: after homing X-max the gantry retreats at least this far from the X-max switch (never less than the limit buffer), so it finishes well clear of the switch and anything mounted at the far end.

inputs.label: Calibration Speed (RPM)
inputs.description: Numeric motor speed used while probing X limits.

inputs.label: Trapezoidal Speed
inputs.description: Enable acceleration and deceleration ramping instead of jumping directly to target speed.

inputs.label: Acceleration (RPM/s)
inputs.description: Acceleration and deceleration rate used for trapezoidal speed ramping.

inputs.label: Steps per Rotation
inputs.description: Stepper pulse count for one full motor rotation. Use 800 when the driver is configured for 800 steps per rotation.

inputs.label: Max Probe Rotations
inputs.description: Maximum motor rotations allowed for each X limit-switch probe before calibration stops with a safety error.

advancedInputs.description: Runtime GPIO step pin for the CoreXY A driver.

advancedInputs.label: CoreXY A Dir Pin
advancedInputs.description: Runtime GPIO direction pin for the CoreXY A driver.

advancedInputs.label: CoreXY B Step Pin
advancedInputs.description: Runtime GPIO step pin for the CoreXY B driver.

advancedInputs.label: CoreXY B Dir Pin
advancedInputs.description: Runtime GPIO direction pin for the CoreXY B driver.

advancedInputs.description: GPIO pin for the X minimum/home limit switch.

advancedInputs.label: X Max Limit Pin
advancedInputs.description: GPIO pin for the X maximum limit switch.

advancedInputs.label: Y Min Limit Pin
advancedInputs.description: GPIO pin for the Y minimum/home limit switch at Y = 0. Probed first to establish the Y origin before X calibration runs.

firmwareRequirements.protocol: Serial commands: SET XY PINS, SET XY LIMITS, CALIBRATE XY <xCm> <yCm> <speedRpm> <trapezoidFlag> <accelerationRpmPerSecond> <stepsPerRotation> <maxProbeRotations> <xCalibrationYRotations> <limitBufferCm>. Firmware nudges clear of any already-pressed limit switch, homes Y-min to set Y = 0, parks xCalibrationYRotations motor rotations clear of the Y switch, then probes X min and X max and records measured X steps per centimeter. block.description: Establishes a known plunger position and primes all 7 pumps. The plungers have no position feedback, so every plunger is first driven in the dispense direction far enough to bottom out on the mechanical hard stop (steppers skip there by design) - that stop becomes the known zero. Then each prime cycle draws the prime volume up and pushes it back out, ending on the stop again.

inputs.label: ESP32 Port
inputs.description: Serial device path for the connected ESP32 syringe board.

inputs.label: Homing Push (µl)
inputs.description: How much the plungers are over-driven in the dispense direction to guarantee they bottom out on the hard stop from any starting position. Should be at least a full syringe stroke; 1500 µl covers a 1 ml syringe with margin.

inputs.label: Prime Volume (µl)
inputs.description: Volume drawn up and pushed back out in each prime cycle.

inputs.label: Prime Cycles
inputs.description: How many draw/push cycles to run after homing.

inputs.label: Speed (RPM)
inputs.description: Motor speed for the homing push and every prime stroke.

advancedInputs.label: Calibration File
advancedInputs.description: Calibration file used to convert dispense amounts into syringe motor steps.

advancedInputs.description: GPIO step pin for syringe head A when saving a reusable hardware preset.
